### Bible Pathways 05/16/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-05-or-16-or-2002-1133434.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 14:17
Points:
- David's life was defined by a deep reverence for the guidance of God's Word.
- He prioritized seeking God in prayer before taking action in battles and crises.
- The Lord established David's victory and caused his fame to spread because of his obedience.
- David demonstrated genuine humility by honoring God alone as the true ruler of the kingdom.
- David's exaltation points forward to Jesus Christ, whom the Father exalted above every name.
